package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"testing"

	"example.com/stroppy-v6-consumer/authoring"
	"github.com/stroppy-io/stroppy/v6"
	"github.com/stroppy-io/stroppy/v6/pkg/bench"
	"github.com/stroppy-io/stroppy/v6/pkg/bench/testkit"
	"github.com/stroppy-io/stroppy/v6/pkg/record"
	"github.com/stroppy-io/stroppy/v6/pkg/report"
)

func TestPreparedSessionCapabilities(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := bench.NewCatalog(authoring.Prepared); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	recorder := &record.Recorder{}
	test := bench.Test{Name: "prepared-consumer", Define: func(d *bench.Def) error {
		d.Execution.WorkerStep("work", func(ctx context.Context, b *bench.Bench) (bench.Action, error) {
			session, err := b.Session(ctx)
			if err != nil { return nil, err }
			statement, err := session.Prepare(ctx, bench.QueryHandle{Name: "one", Text: "SELECT 1"})
			if err != nil { return nil, err }
			return func(ctx context.Context, b *bench.Bench) error {
				return session.BeginTx(ctx, bench.BeginOpts{Isolation: bench.IsoReadCommitted}, func(tx *bench.Tx) error {
					return tx.ExecPrepared(ctx, statement, nil)
				})
			}, nil
		}, bench.SharedIterations(1, 3))
		return d.Execution.Err()
	}}
	if _, err := testkit.Record(t.Context(), test, recorder, bench.RunOptions{}); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	counts := map[string]int{}
	for _, operation := range recorder.Operations() { counts[operation.Kind]++ }
	if counts["prepare"] != 1 || counts["query"] != 3 || counts["statement_close"] != 1 || counts["session_close"] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected prepared lifecycle: %v", counts)
	}
}

func TestAuthorCapabilities(t *testing.T) {
	catalog, err := bench.NewCatalog(authoring.Query, authoring.Accounts, authoring.Mirror)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	application, err := stroppy.NewCatalog(catalog)
	if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
	for _, name := range []string{"example/query", "example/accounts", "example/mirror"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			result, err := application.Run(t.Context(), &stroppy.RunRequest{
				Test: name,
				Drivers: map[string]bench.DriverConfig{
					"": {Kind: bench.DriverNoop},
					"primary": {Kind: bench.DriverNoop},
					"secondary": {Kind: bench.DriverNoop},
				},
				Params: bench.ParamInputs{CLI: map[string]string{"iterations": "7"}},
				Metrics: &bench.MetricsConfig{Quiet: true, SummaryWriter: io.Discard},
			})
			if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
			if result.Status != report.StatusCompleted { t.Fatalf("status = %s", result.Status) }
			if name == "example/accounts" {
				if *result.Metrics["account_transfers"].Total != 7 { t.Fatal("transfer count") }
				if len(result.WorkloadReports) != 1 || !json.Valid(result.WorkloadReports[0].Data) {
					t.Fatal("missing accounts payload")
				}
				if *result.Metrics["insert_rows_total"].Total != 100 { t.Fatal("load count") }
				if *result.Metrics["successful_transactions_total"].Total != 7 { t.Fatal("logical transaction count") }
			}
			if name == "example/mirror" {
				if *result.Metrics["mirror_queries"].Total != 14 || len(result.Metrics["mirror_queries"].Series) != 2 {
					t.Fatal("named database metrics")
				}
				if len(result.Drivers) != 3 { t.Fatal("named database descriptions") }
			}
		})
	}
}
